description.en: Lohi operations beyond marketing: catalog health and quality, duplicate novels, request/edit/violation queues, enrichment, Litrans jobs, comments, App Store reviews, SEO and pricing. Money and content takedowns stay with a person.
description.vi: Vận hành Lohi ngoài marketing: sức khoẻ và chất lượng kho truyện, truyện trùng, hàng đợi yêu cầu, sửa chữ, báo cáo vi phạm, làm giàu dữ liệu, dịch Litrans, bình luận, đánh giá App Store, SEO và giá. Tiền bạc và gỡ nội dung là quyết định của người.

tools.description: Run the api catalog-health checks (stale ongoing novels, chapter-number gaps, empty or very short recent chapters, recent chapters still mostly Chinese, quality: published novels missing a cover, synopsis, genres or any chapter), keep a findings table, and raise one Cần bạn card only for what a person must act on (wake/notify when that set changes; resolves_need when it clears). Each run scans a bounded window of novels per check (pages x limit), never the whole catalog.
tools.name: catalog_health
tools.title: Sức khoẻ kho truyện

tools.description: BUILDER ONLY (founder's Mac, needs the local CLI_CATALOG_DB; never grant it to a server Soot). Read the cli crawler catalog (CLI_CATALOG_DB, SQLite, opened read-only): sources with work left, crawls stuck in "crawling", failed crawls grouped by error, sources that stopped moving, radar finds not yet onboarded. One Cần bạn card only for stuck, repeated failures or a stalled source. Without CLI_CATALOG_DB it answers a quiet skipped.
tools.name: crawl_watch
tools.title: Theo dõi thu thập truyện (Mac)

tools.description: Pull comments to screen from the api: those readers reported (flagged) and the newest visible ones (recent), minus the ones already decided. Short thanks, praise and emoji among the newest are kept by the tool itself (auto_kept) and never reach the model; notify is true only when something needs a judgment. Answers {items:[{id, source, body, report_reason}]} and the rules to judge them by. Comment text only: no author, no reader.
tools.name: comments_pull
tools.title: Lấy bình luận cần xem

tools.description: Apply the model verdicts [{id, verdict: spam|abuse|scam|ok|unsure, confidence, why}]. Only spam/abuse/scam at confidence >= 0.9 is hidden through the api (at most 15 per call); a confident ok on a reader-flagged comment is kept; everything else is escalated to one Cần bạn card. dry_run records without calling the api.
tools.name: comments_decide
tools.title: Quyết định bình luận

tools.description: Apply a person's decision on a comment that was escalated: hide it (with a reason) or keep it (restores it if hidden). Only an escalated comment can be resolved here.
tools.name: comments_resolve
tools.title: Xử lý bình luận chờ người

tools.description: Read the Lohi app public reviews from Apple's customer-reviews feed (APPSTORE_APP_ID, APPSTORE_COUNTRY; no sign-in), store the new ones (no reviewer name) and list the 1-3 star reviews that still need a reply. notify: true when there are new reviews.
tools.name: appstore_sync
tools.title: Đọc đánh giá App Store

tools.description: Store a Vietnamese reply draft (at most 1000 characters, no email or phone) for one review id from appstore_sync. Posts nothing.
tools.name: appstore_draft
tools.title: Soạn phản hồi đánh giá

tools.description: Gather every drafted, not yet posted App Store reply into one Cần bạn card (no model): a new batch replaces the open card, none left settles it. Its "Đăng" option wakes the Soot to post them with appstore_post, which still waits for an operator's approval. Never posts.
tools.name: appstore_drafts
tools.title: Phản hồi chờ duyệt

tools.description: Post one drafted reply through the App Store Connect API (ASC_API_KEY, the founder's key). Without the key it answers needs_credential naming ASC_API_KEY and posts nothing; it never invents a key. Operator approval of the exact reply is expected before calling.
tools.name: appstore_post
tools.title: Đăng phản hồi lên App Store

tools.description: From Search Console (the same GSC_GOOGLE sign-in as marketing): lohi2.com/truyen pages with impressions but a low CTR for their position, or sitting at positions 8-20, with the top queries, the page's current title and meta, one concrete change each, and up to 3 content opportunities in the shape company-loop digest_save takes. Read-only; the web app is not changed.
tools.name: seo_report
tools.title: Báo cáo SEO trang truyện

tools.description: Read the scoreboard's plans and cohorts (api.lohi2.com, last N full days) and report the payer funnel, plan mix with revenue per start, cohort retention, and hypotheses to test. Read-only: it never changes a price, plan or discount; each suggestion is marked decision: founder.
tools.name: pricing_report
tools.title: Báo cáo giá và gói

tools.description: Curator. List pending reader requests (default type novel; also chapters, quality), paid votes first and flagged priority paid. Before listing, settles the obvious ones with no model: a request whose novel is already published is attached and marked done, an exact duplicate title is merged (auto_resolved says which). Page with next_cursor. A request that reached the api's auto-onboard score and holds a day's slot (auto_onboard) is approved and its onboard job opened already approved (approved_by policy:auto_onboard), once per request.
tools.name: requests_pending
tools.title: Yêu cầu truyện đang chờ

tools.description: Curator. approve a pending request, mark it done (the novel is already published) or merge it into an active duplicate (target_id). Approve with kind onboard|refresh (+ title, source_url, novel_slug, chapters "A-B", optional source) also opens the catalog job: a refresh of an existing novel starts approved, an onboard of a new novel waits for the daily card. Bookkeeping: no reader sees a refusal. When the api answers autoOnboard (the request reached the score and holds a day's slot) the onboard starts approved too.
tools.name: request_accept
tools.title: Chấp nhận yêu cầu truyện

tools.description: Curator. Reject a pending request with a reason the requester can read (at least a short sentence; the api echoes it, it does not store it yet). Waits for an operator's approval of the exact reason.
tools.name: request_reject
tools.title: Từ chối yêu cầu truyện

tools.description: Curator. List reader edit suggestions nobody judged yet, oldest first (limit, cursor from next_cursor). Read-only.
tools.name: edits_pending
tools.title: Hàng đợi sửa chữ của độc giả

tools.description: Curator. The paragraphs around ONE edit suggestion, whether the chapter moved since, and how comparable edits were decided. Read it before edit_verdict. Read-only.
tools.name: edits_context
tools.title: Ngữ cảnh một gợi ý sửa

tools.description: Curator. Record accept / reject / unsure with an honest confidence (0-100) and one Vietnamese sentence. This is a verdict, not a decision: the api combines it with the submitter's trust to apply the edit, drop it or hand it to a moderator.
tools.name: edit_verdict
tools.title: Nhận định gợi ý sửa

tools.description: Curator. Open takedown / violation reports, oldest first, with the 48h deadline and an overdue flag. The reporter is never shown. Page with next_offset. Read-only.
tools.name: violations_list
tools.title: Báo cáo vi phạm đang mở

tools.description: Curator. Acknowledge a report, or dismiss a NON-copyright one, with a note. Removing content and dismissing a copyright claim stay with a person (the api answers copyright_needs_person). Waits for an operator's approval of the exact note.
tools.name: violation_resolve
tools.title: Xử lý báo cáo vi phạm

tools.description: Curator. Put one catalogue novel (slug) in the enrichment pipeline for tags and synopsis proposals. Proposals still wait for review; a novel outside the catalogue is refused (not_catalogue).
tools.name: enrichment_enqueue
tools.title: Đưa truyện vào làm giàu dữ liệu

tools.description: Curator. One page of published novels missing a cover, a real synopsis, genres or any published chapter (problems filters: cover, synopsis, genres, chapters). Page with next_cursor. Read-only; catalog_health with check quality keeps the findings.
tools.name: quality_list
tools.title: Chất lượng kho truyện

tools.description: Curator. Scan a bounded window of the catalog for novels whose titles are alike (accent-folded, typo-tolerant, index-backed in the api; also the same Chinese title). Keeps one finding per pair (check duplicate) and answers both slugs with the similarity. It never merges or archives: that is a person's decision.
tools.name: duplicates_scan
tools.title: Truyện trùng lặp

tools.description: Curator. Cross-novel Litrans job health: counts by status, the longest queue wait, running jobs with no heartbeat, recent failures. Keeps findings and raises one Cần bạn card when jobs are stalled, queued too long or failing repeatedly.
tools.name: litrans_health
tools.title: Sức khoẻ dịch Litrans

tools.description: Curator. Ask the Workshop builder (the founder's Mac) for crawler work: kind crawl | onboard | refresh | repair, subject "<source>/<novel>" (a repair adds "#<from>-<to>"), and why. Waits for an operator's approval of the exact request; once approved the job is queued for the builder. An open duplicate answers the existing job.
tools.name: catalog_job_request
tools.title: Xin việc thu thập cho Workshop

tools.description: Curator, no model. Fold the builder's catalog_job_events (running, done, failed, radar) back into the catalog_jobs table. A done onboard or refresh queues the translation of the chapters it added (translate_step); a refresh the radar policy opened is announced to readers once translated. Posts the request's stage: translating on a done onboard, failed (cause blocked_copyright, no_source or failed; the api refunds donated LT once) on a stopped one, with the fixed reader-facing line asking for a link on no_source. Radar finds from the Mac open one refresh job each (approved_by policy:radar) for novels with readers, inside a daily cap. notify is true only when a job failed.
tools.name: catalog_jobs_sync
tools.title: Cập nhật kết quả việc thu thập

tools.description: Builder (Mac). First report how the jobs this Mac started ended (state, novel_slug, chapters, copyright from the runner's result), then list the approved catalog jobs of the operations team that this Mac has not started. With autorun true it also starts them (at most max_start, default 3) as deterministic cli sequences with no model: refresh and repair run onboard --chapters A-B --chapters-only [--overwrite] --no-announce; an onboard of a new novel runs dry-run, copyright check, then stops blocked_copyright or does the real run (draft for a request). A request whose title matches no single catalog novel ends failed no_source (the api refunds donors); a request link the catalog never saw comes back as needs_source with an instruction. notify is true only for needs_source or a job that could not start.
tools.name: catalog_jobs_pull
tools.title: Việc thu thập đã duyệt

tools.description: Builder (Mac). Run ONE approved job by id as the same deterministic cli sequence autorun uses (argv arrays, no shell, detached, logged under the pack state dir). For a job answered needs_source, pass source and novel (the cli slugs of the link's novel; the source must be the link's own site and the catalog must hold the row). Reports a running event to the operations team.
tools.name: catalog_job_run
tools.title: Chạy một việc thu thập

tools.description: Builder (Mac). Report the end (done or failed, with a short detail) of a job that Claude Code ran from catalog_job_run's instruction. state blocked_copyright (with copyright) stops an onboard that matches a rights holder; a done onboard or refresh carries novel_slug and chapters.
tools.name: catalog_job_report
tools.title: Báo kết quả việc thu thập

tools.description: BUILDER ONLY (founder's Mac, needs CLI_DIR and the local catalog). Tool-first, no model: one sweep at a time, started detached with the cli's own radar (at most 60 novels per sweep, prod-synced, not finished, no copyright flag), harvested on the next call. Novels that gained chapters become `radar` events on the operations queue catalog_job_events; the curator's policy turns them into refresh jobs. notify is true only when a sweep failed or never finished.
tools.name: radar_scan
tools.title: Quét chương mới của truyện đang theo dõi (Mac)

tools.description: Curator, no model. Files ONE Cần bạn card per day listing every requested onboard job (new novels) with its copyright result. Refresh jobs never appear.
tools.name: onboard_card
tools.title: Thẻ duyệt truyện mới trong ngày

tools.description: Card option only, never a model's call (it refuses any run that is not the card's own schedule step). Runs when the person presses Duyệt or Từ chối on the daily onboard card: approves or declines the jobs stored with that card's one-time nonce. The click is the approval, so it is not operator-gated.
tools.name: catalog_jobs_answer
tools.title: Bấm thẻ truyện mới

tools.description: Curator. After the person answers the daily card: approve or decline the listed requested onboard jobs, or ack a copyright stop. Approving is the person's decision, so an operator approves this exact call.
tools.name: catalog_jobs_decide
tools.title: Trả lời thẻ truyện mới

tools.description: Curator. Queue a Litrans translation of at most 10 chapters of one novel (from, to, optional request_id). beyond_first_batch true is allowed only when the api reports enough active readers.
tools.name: translate_start
tools.title: Xin dịch một đợt chương

tools.description: Curator, no model. One tick of every open translation: start it, wait for the Litrans job, pull the chapters, then mark the chapters request translated so requesters are told. A new novel's first batch from a request goes to the quality gate instead (stage quality; release_step closes it at release).
tools.name: translate_step
tools.title: Đẩy việc dịch đi tiếp

tools.description: Curator. Mark a request done or translated (the api tells the requesters) and keep the outcome with the novel and chapters.
tools.name: request_finish
tools.title: Đóng yêu cầu có kết quả

tools.description: Curator. List pending support actions the curator may run itself (requeue_crawl, requeue_tts, fix_chapter) with their chapter span and reporter count; wide ones, review tasks (needs_review) and a person's holds (needs_person) are flagged. Read-only.
tools.name: fixes_pull
tools.title: Việc sửa chương đang chờ

tools.description: Curator. Room reports the automatic check could not act on (Lỗi dịch, Sai tên, Lặp đoạn, Đọc sai tên, or a chapter that looked healthy), grouped by novel, kind and 10-chapter window with the number of distinct readers, the detail counts and up to 3 reader notes. Read-only; it files nothing.
tools.name: reports_open
tools.title: Báo lỗi chưa ai xem

tools.description: Curator. Run one pending support action inside the api's daily caps. A wide scope is not run (it goes to a person). The chapter is re-checked later by fix_recheck.
tools.name: fix_execute
tools.title: Chạy một việc sửa chương

tools.description: Curator. The person saw a fix card (wide scope, refused or failed): stop carding those action ids.
tools.name: fix_ack
tools.title: Đã xem việc sửa không tự làm được

tools.description: Curator. Force re-translate ONE chapter (api cap 20 per day).
tools.name: chapter_retranslate
tools.title: Dịch lại một chương

tools.description: Curator. Regenerate the audio of ONE chapter with the voice it used (api cap 20 per day).
tools.name: chapter_tts
tools.title: Tạo lại audio một chương

tools.description: Curator, no model. Look again at fixed chapters (content health / audio): a pass is closed, a fail or a wide scope becomes one Cần bạn card.
tools.name: fix_recheck
tools.title: Kiểm lại chương đã sửa

tools.description: Catalog Exec, no model. Run every pending support action the api will run as it stands (re-crawl, re-voice, a reader-quoted text replacement inside the api's bounds), within the api's daily caps. Returns to_review: review tasks (reports the automatic check could not judge) for the model, each once. Wide scopes and a person's holds are carded by fix_recheck.
tools.name: fixes_run
tools.title: Chạy các việc sửa chương sẵn sàng

tools.description: Catalog Exec. One review task: the reported issue, Lạc Phong's summary, how many readers reported it, the text bounds, and the chapter text (clipped) with its repeated paragraphs. Never who reported it. Read-only.
tools.name: fix_context
tools.title: Xem việc cần soát

tools.description: Catalog Exec. Decide one review task: replace (find = a verbatim quote from the chapter, replace = the corrected text; the api re-checks the quote and its bounds, then runs it), revoice, recrawl, not_reproduced (closed with the reason), or needs_person (a card). Lạc Phong tells every reporter when it settles.
tools.name: fix_resolve
tools.title: Kết luận việc cần soát

tools.description: Catalog Exec. Read the quality sample of a new novel's first batch (at most 10 chapters, api-bounded): per chapter the source and translated length, leftover Chinese, Book Bible names missing from the translation, audio; the api's thresholds; the gate so far. Read only.
tools.name: quality_sample
tools.title: Mẫu chất lượng truyện mới

tools.description: Catalog Exec. Post the verdict on a sample (score 0-1, one Vietnamese reason; optional per-chapter scores). pass: the api dispatches pro TTS for the batch, platform-paid inside its daily cap (deferred past it), and the request moves to audio. fail: the api answers next = retranslate (this tool re-translates the named chapters, else the batch, and the batch is sampled again) or human (one Cần bạn card). A replayed verdict changes nothing; dry_run writes nothing.
tools.name: quality_verdict
tools.title: Kết luận chất lượng

tools.description: Catalog Exec, no model. One tick of every new novel on its way to release: a retranslated batch goes back for a new sample, deferred audio is retried, dispatched audio is checked and, once every sampled chapter has it, the request is marked released and closed (the api tells the readers). Wakes only when a sample waits for a verdict.
tools.name: release_step
tools.title: Đưa truyện mới tới phát hành

ASC_API_KEY.description: JSON {"key_id","issuer_id","private_key"} của khoá App Store Connect API (quyền Customer Support) do chủ tài khoản Apple tạo; chỉ để đăng phản hồi đánh giá. Không có khoá thì Soot chỉ soạn nháp. Nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.
ASC_API_KEY.title: Khoá App Store Connect API

GSC_GOOGLE.description: Đăng nhập Google trong Nest để Soot đọc số hiển thị, lượt bấm và vị trí của các trang truyện (chỉ quyền đọc). Cùng đăng nhập với gói marketing.
GSC_GOOGLE.title: Google Search Console

PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.description: Khoá agent_mod dùng chung cũ. Chỉ là phương án dự phòng khi chưa có PRODUCT_AGENT_KEY; sẽ bị bỏ sau khi mọi Soot đã đổi khoá (docs/AGENT-KEYS.md). Chỉ gửi tới PRODUCT_API_URL.
PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.title: Khoá agent_mod dùng chung (đã lỗi thời)

PRODUCT_AGENT_KEY.description: Khoá API của Soot này, đúng một vai trò agent (agent_analyst, agent_moderator, agent_curator, agent_catalog_exec hoặc agent_marketing) tuỳ công cụ nó dùng; mỗi công cụ ghi vai trò cần trong README. Chỉ gửi tới PRODUCT_API_URL. Nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.
PRODUCT_AGENT_KEY.title: Khoá agent Lohi

tables.description: Điều bảng sức khoẻ kho truyện đã thấy: truyện ngừng cập nhật, thiếu chương, chương trống hoặc chưa dịch.
tables.name: findings

tables.description: Bình luận đã đưa cho Soot xem và quyết định cho từng cái: ẩn, giữ, hay chờ người.
tables.name: comments

tables.description: Đánh giá công khai trên App Store, bản nháp phản hồi và trạng thái đăng.
tables.name: reviews

tables.description: Trạng thái nhỏ: thẻ Cần bạn đã báo, để không báo lại khi chưa có gì đổi.
tables.name: state

tables.description: Việc thu thập curator xin Workshop làm (sau khi người duyệt): thu thập, onboard, làm mới, sửa chương.
tables.name: catalog_jobs

tables.description: Hàng đợi chỉ thêm: máy Workshop báo việc thu thập đang chạy, xong hay lỗi. catalog_jobs_sync gộp vào catalog_jobs.
tables.name: catalog_job_events

tables.description: Điều đã xảy ra với mỗi yêu cầu rời hàng đợi: gắn vào truyện có sẵn, trùng, xong, đã dịch, bị chặn bản quyền.
tables.name: request_outcomes

tables.description: Đợt dịch đầu của truyện vừa lên hoặc vừa thêm chương: xin, chờ job Litrans, kéo về, báo người yêu cầu.
tables.name: translations

tables.description: Việc sửa chương đã chạy và kết quả kiểm lại: chờ kiểm, đạt, hỏng, phạm vi rộng.
tables.name: fix_checks
